notes.title: PULMO Demo is out!
notes.content: [p][b]PULMO DEMO IS OUT![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40036758/a026d5641d9b5b416cdaf228486946fca438c302.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]PULMO is the ideological continuation of ALVEOLE and the second part in a trilogy about the human journey. Our project explores human behavior in a society where everyone will find their own meanings. Your goal is to change the environment around you to influence people's behavior by solving spatial puzzles. The crowd in the game acts according to its own rules, sometimes helping, sometimes interfering, but always reacting to your actions.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="4DHgLz4BAuA;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Alveole is taking part in the Indie Cup Celebration 2021!
notes.content:
Alveole is taking part in the Indie Cup Celebration 2021 on Steam! In addition to the fact that our project is being sold at a discount, we want to tell you about a number of other cool projects that have already been released from this event:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40036758/2b20ee728c4880970418be89eb117d3036fcc4d5.jpg[/img]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/938560/INMOST/]Inmost[/url] - pixelated platformer with a distinctive visual style and interesting storyline.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40036758/0f9d1c8aaad2eac0988bb8c89bec152bcd80abf9.jpg[/img]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/625960/Stoneshard/]Stoneshard[/url] - turn-based pixel RPG from the authors of "12 is better than 6".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40036758/782c9037d79c2861ba37d8752b9eac6d9b180b2a.jpg[/img]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1282730/Loop_Hero/]Loop Hero[/url] - game from regular winners of any jams and competitions, the authors of PDTA.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40036758/f04407a77982252f4782b6d19f1b3316a72cc8b7.jpg[/img]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/766000/Kensh/]Kenshō[/url] - a puzzle from regular attendees of Apple shows.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40036758/73fec435c1963cfa62ffd1f535fe5e44e11bdffc.jpg[/img]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1444020/Reactor_Tech/]Reactor Tech²[/url] - to roll out such a good game at the age of 17, be sure to familiarize yourself with it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40036758/303218fa78d19a9661d6a48e6137179643aff51e.jpg[/img]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/922710/Knightin/]Knightin'+[/url] - A cute action game with exploration elements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40036758/3bf0747773b412ff910fa2767a7caabbc9858e3c.jpg[/img]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/814530/Death_Crown/]Death Crown[/url] - very cool RTS from CO5MONAUT, who is now making a very cool game about cold weather)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40036758/c8971b6e3c4898eb9aa0382b873309f5826b1cb1.jpg[/img]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1197570/Until_We_Die/]Until We Die[/url] - KTC in the metro setting, what could be better?

More games can be found here [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/indiecup2021]INDIE CUP CELEBRATION 2021[/url]

notes.title: 1.2.0 Update is out!
notes.content:
1.2.0 Update is out! This update will bring Quality of Life improvements and will add the gallery at the end of the game, so you could view all photo cards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40036758/7c8948cb2f68c296cdab4a181e241f87745dcfe0.png[/img]

Change list:
[list]
[*]Added gallery
[*]Updated localization
[*]Performance enhancements
[*]UI/UX improvements
[*]Minor fixes
[/list]
